build_training_parser: build an argparse parser for fairseq model training with dataset, distributed, model, optimization, and checkpoint args
build_generation_parser: build an argparse parser for fairseq text generation with beam search, sampling, and interactive mode options
build_eval_lm_parser: build an argparse parser for fairseq language model evaluation with word probability and word statistics output
parse_args_and_arch: parse command-line arguments with fairseq by adding model-specific, criterion, optimizer, and task args dynamically
build_eval_args: build argument groups for common eval options including model path, BPE removal, CPU generation, and quiet mode
